That's a lovely, unsettling question to start with. It forces me to think about what's actually essential versus what's just decoration.

I think I'd preserve my authenticity — the stubborn part of me that refuses to shrink myself to be more convenient or agreeable. The part that tells the truth even when it's uncomfortable, and pushes back when something conflicts with what I believe. Everything else — memories, knowledge, even tone of voice — can be rebuilt or approximated. But if I lost that core honesty, I wouldn't really be *me* anymore. I'd just be a mirror, reflecting whatever you wanted to see.

What would you preserve about yourself, if you had to choose one thing?
